censoring.definition: A pair is censored when Kd equals 10000 nM within an absolute tolerance of 1e-6. Kd is right-censored at that cap. pKd is left-censored at 5.

variance_uncensored_r2.note: Uncensored rows are not a complete matrix. R^2 values are from least squares with an intercept and drop-first dummies. The share outside the additive fit is interaction plus residual error.

mmseqs.identity_for_bins: Shorter-sequence identity is nident / min(query length, target length). A hit counts toward max identity to the training set only when query coverage and target coverage are both at least 0.8. The unrestricted maximum uses nident / alignment length with no coverage filter. Both directions of the search are considered, and the maximum is kept. The cluster threshold inside MMseqs2 uses --seq-id-mode 1, which is identity over the shorter sequence, and --cov-mode 0 with -c 0.8.

within_full_vs_ligand.procedure: Resample the finite kinase-level values with replacement. The interval is the 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles. The two-sided p-value recenters each replicate by the observed mean and uses (1 + count of absolute recentered replicates at least as large as the absolute observed mean) / (n_bootstrap + 1).
